notes: Source PNG is preserved byte-for-byte; crop coordinates do not redraw or resample sprites.
Five facings only exist for normal OneHanded Idle. Missing facings/poses need runtime fallback.
Death joins two consecutive source rows into one sequence.
SpitOut uses fixed panels to preserve the original airborne offsets.
Shadow deliberately retains panel-background RGB169/223/216 as foreground.
Directions on special non-directional clips are catalogued as Front; do not infer additional drawn frames.
SpitOut starts below the text label and uses a common airborne anchor; only blank panel pixels may be trimmed during packing.
Alternate Pet and PitRespawn use full sprite rows, excluding their labels.
